title: Field names matching the reconstructor internal marker syntax are silently deleted
rationale: NP-022 in the structural domain. processArrays skips any key that starts with "__" and ends with "__" so it can hide its own holders, but the check runs against every user key at every level, and the two conditions can overlap so "___" matches too. The flatten side handles these names perfectly, which makes this purely a reconstructor namespace bug.
catchesBugClass: Reserved-namespace collision between reconstructor internals and legitimate user field names, including the overlapping-match case that a naive length>=4 guard would still get wrong.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the same collision at the ARRAY-element level, where reconstructArray strips markers by exact name rather than by pattern. It also cannot catch the "_value" sentinel collision, a different reserved name on a different code path.

predicted.detail: Flattening is correct and lossless; processArrays then drops both __meta__ and ___ by the marker-skip test. No error, no warning, no count discrepancy reported anywhere.
